title: Light from the Sky
description: Welcome to Luz del Cielo ✨ A peaceful coastal retreat in the heart of Rincón, Puerto Rico. Enjoy ocean breezes, modern comfort, stylish interiors, and a private pool just minutes from beautiful beaches, restaurants, shops, and surf spots. Perfect for couples, families, friends, or remote work escapes. Relax, recharge, and experience unforgettable sunsets in paradise 🌴🌅 Your perfect Puerto Rico getaway awaits.The spaceEnjoy a stylish and comfortable stay in the heart of Rincón. This thoughtfully designed apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, spacious living areas, comfortable bedrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a private balcony with beautiful ocean views. Whether you're here to relax, work remotely, or explore the area, Luz del Cielo offers everything you need for a memorable stay.Guest accessGuests have full access to the entire apartment, including all bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, living and dining areas, balcony, and designated parking spaces. Guests also have access to the building's shared amenities, including the pool and common areas. Self check-in is available for a smooth and convenient arrival.Other things to noteFor your comfort and convenience, the building features a backup generator for common areas and a water reserve system (cistern). Enjoy secure parking, controlled building access, and easy access to Rincón’s beautiful beaches, restaurants, shops, and attractions.

title: Happiness 2 - Lovely 1BR/1BA poolside apt @ Sandy
description: Happiness By the Beach is located in the heart of Puntas, Rincon PR. We are right across the street from the beautiful Sandy beach, breathtaking beach views, restaurants, mini market, surfboard rentals, beach front yoga classes and more. At our place you'll enjoy beautiful, elegant, modern and comfortable lodgings with access to a beautiful patio with a relaxing pool with sun loungers for sunbathing, grill area, and luxurious lounge area patio furniture under an opulent pergola. Stay, BE HAPPY!The spaceHappiness By the Beach is an exclusive, beautiful, modern, recently renovated building with 2 apartments and two studios on the first floor. The second floor has two separate apartments with different access. The main entrance leads to a beautiful patio with an opulent pergola, underneath which there is an exquisite lounging area with luxurious outdoor patio furniture and an awesome grill area. in the patio you'll also find beautifully relaxing pool, a gorgeous mural by local artist, Albert Padilla, and sun loungers for sunbathing. The entrances to Units 1-3 are on the right side of the patio with glass doors and windows to let in the light and to appreciate the view of the patio from the inside. Hotel-like black out curtains are installed for the guest to use should you desire privacyUnit 2 in a one bedroom apartment with a full sized bed, a futon in the living room, bathroom, kitchen, dining table for 4 plus 2 extra stools, workspace in the bedroom, and TV in the living room. Units 2 features include: Futon sleeper, Plush full bed, bed and bath linens, flat screen smart TV, cable, complimentary secured wireless internet, private bathroom, microwave oven, fridge, coffee maker, stove top, shampoo and conditioner, body wash, and beach towels. The enclosed property includes a beautiful pool, sun loungers, luxury patio furniture, gas and coal grills (BBQ) and outdoor shower. The whole building is equipped with an automatic generator to protect your vacation investment from common island power outages.Guest accessAt the property, guest have access to pool, outdoor shower, gas and coal grill (BBQ), sun loungers and outdoor patio lounge.The neighborhood in very walkable, but we recommend you have a car to go downtown, visit other beaches and other parts of the island and to do grocery shopping.There is free onsite parking at the property and on the street.Other things to noteWhile we provide internet service, generator in case of very common power outages and water in case water goes out as well, we do ask that you are conscious that these are not fail proof. We have a regular maintenance schedule to keep our premises and our services in the best conditions possible. If any of these were to fail during your stay rest assured, we will do everything in our power to resolve the issue in a timely manner, also taking into consideration the maintenance personnel and technician’s availability and abilities.
amenities: Shared pool - available all year, open specific hours

title: Casa Dulce: Modern House, Breathtaking Sea Views
description: Enjoy incredible panoramic ocean views from the privacy of a spacious, modern house, Casa Dulce. You can be on the beach in 5 minutes or relax in the stylish space. The open gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream. All local activities are within a 5-7 minute drive, beaches, restaurants, shopping and town center. Casa Dulce runs on solar power, so it's immune to PR's power outages. A/Cs in the bedrooms only. This is an unforgettable experience you'll want to return to.The spaceOpen-style, spacious house with breathtaking views. Chef's kitchen with counter seating opens to large living room, which in turn leads to a beautiful terrace that can be shaded. Two private bedrooms each have en suite bathrooms with a shower, one of which can also be accessed from the living room. Each bedroom has a desk, one of them with a computer monitor, so Casa Dulce can easily be your remote work location.Washer and dryer downstairs.Ceiling fans throughout, A/C in the bedrooms only.Guest accessLarge private driveway, lockbox for self-service access.Other things to noteBeach equipment available for guest use, including beach towels, chairs, umbrella and a wakeboard.This is a mountain house, so you get to enjoy nature - that means bird songs, occasional cow mooing, geckos, lizards and insects outdoors, especially in the rainy season. Indoors ultrasonic plug-in devices keep mosquitos away.
amenities: Coffee maker: drip coffee maker, french press

description: Pet and smoke free beach house.Beautiful sunsets over Desecheo island in Caribbean sea. Wave watching, star gazing. Even the rain is awesome here. Just few steps from the back door and sea is outdoor shower to rinse off the sand. This 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom is all you need on this tropical island where outdoor living is the best. Sorry, no parties or sleepovers. No fishing from the property, our backyard is a coral reef great for swimming snorkeling and diving.The spaceJust beachy and peaceful. Clean and comfortable, smoke and pet free home. We strive to exceed your expectations. You may love to explore the awesome coral reef right in our backyard. Please enjoy our outdoor shower to keep the sand out of the islands sensitive sewer system, shake your towels and swimsuit outside, not inside the indoor shower. Thank you. Greatly appreciated.Guest accessEasy access, from the street behind the sliding gate is private entry. Back door will lead you to the patio outdoor living area and the Caribbean sea access (just few steps). Please keep the front gate and beach gate closed. The locked door next to the bedroom has a sign Private, not a second bathroom. Outside storage is also Private. Thank you 😊Other things to notePlease be respectful guests, if two people checking in two people should be checking out, If you lose or misplace or brake something replace it or let us knowClose the window behind your bed when leaving the house, we get surprise rains. Turn off all lights, fans and air conditioning when leaving the house. Also outside lights off before retiring. It gets windy on the island please use provided door stops to prevent door slamming and use provided drying rack instead of our furniture, lamps or ceiling fans for all wet items . Please no fishing or fish killing on the property or in the house, no coconut braking inside or outside. Please don't leave your trash when leaving, use grey trashcan by the gate. Thank you for your cooperation. Enjoy your stay.
